title: 3.8.18 Lab: Save a State Object by Key
description: Turn a state object into JSON text and store it under a key so it survives the page closing. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create the state object
steps.instructions: Create a variable called state holding an object with at least two properties, for example a score and a level.

steps.title: Store it under a key
steps.instructions: Use localStorage.setItem to save the object under a key you choose. Remember the store holds strings, so the object has to be converted with JSON.stringify first.

steps.title: Read the key back
steps.instructions: Use console.log with localStorage.getItem on the same key to confirm text was stored.

requirements.title: State object declared
requirements.description: Declares an object with curly braces
